paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.07% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+6.18%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.92%). Brent crude changed -2.46% to 100.07. Gold changed +0.19% to 4,187.7998. Bitcoin changed +1.01% to 85,706.2109. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.273%, a relative move of +0.34%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-9.92%) and Occidental (+7.02%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Auditor RSM explores IPO to ward off private equity-backed rivals (FT Home). Accounting firm has been sounding out bankers and revamping internal systems to give itself the option of a stock market flotation Deals and capital markets: EG Group delays IPO plans and draws takeover interest (FT Markets). Petrol station empire had filed for New York listing aiming to raise about $1bn at $9bn valuation Central banks and macro: French central bank head warns country at risk of being ‘strangled by interest rates’ (FT Markets). Emmanuel Moulin says France can still reassure bond investors despite ‘serious and worrying’ market moves in recent days Central banks and macro: Philippines’ central bank braces for ‘Godzilla’ El Niño (FT World). Severe Pacific Ocean weather event could fuel inflationary pressures and hit agricultural production across region Geopolitics and trade: Middle Eastern oil exports rise to highest level since Iran war began (FT Markets). Shuttle services through Strait of Hormuz have brought shipments to more than 80% of prewar daily average
